<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[/**
 * CLM APPROVER DASHBOARD — Client Script (FIXED)
 * Fix: calls refreshRequests() on init to load data from server
 */

api.controller = function($scope) {
    var c = this;

    // ── Init — don't override server data with empty arrays ────
    c.data.filteredRequests = [];
    c.data.selectedRequest  = null;
    c.data.deciding         = false;
    c.data.decisionDone     = false;
    c.data.filterSegment    = '';
    c.data.filterType       = '';
    c.data.filterDeviation  = '';
    c.data.decisionError    = '';
    c.data.refreshing       = false;
    c.data.lastRefreshed    = '';

    // ── Build filtered list from whatever requests exist ───────
    c.applyFilters = function() {
        var seg = c.data.filterSegment   || '';
        var typ = c.data.filterType      || '';
        var dev = c.data.filterDeviation || '';

        c.data.filteredRequests = (c.data.requests || []).filter(function(req) {
            if (seg && req.segment       !== seg)         return false;
            if (typ && req.customer_type !== typ)         return false;
            if (dev === 'deviation' && !req.is_deviation) return false;
            if (dev === 'standard'  &&  req.is_deviation) return false;
            return true;
        });
    };

    // Watch filters
    $scope.$watch(function() { return c.data.filterSegment;   }, function() { c.applyFilters(); });
    $scope.$watch(function() { return c.data.filterType;      }, function() { c.applyFilters(); });
    $scope.$watch(function() { return c.data.filterDeviation; }, function() { c.applyFilters(); });

    // ── KEY FIX: Load requests on init ─────────────────────────
    // Server sends data on page load via data.requests
    // But we also call refresh explicitly to ensure fresh data
    if (c.data.requests && c.data.requests.length > 0) {
        // Server already returned data on initial load
        c.applyFilters();
        c.data.lastRefreshed = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
    } else {
        // Server returned empty — call refresh explicitly
        c.refreshRequests();
    }

    // ── Refresh ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.refreshRequests = function() {
        c.data.refreshing = true;
        c.server.get({ action: 'refresh' })
        .then(function(r) {
            c.data.refreshing    = false;
            c.data.lastRefreshed = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            if (r.data.requests) {
                c.data.requests = r.data.requests;
            } else {
                c.data.requests = [];
            }
            c.applyFilters();
        }).catch(function() {
            c.data.refreshing = false;
            c.data.requests   = c.data.requests || [];
            c.applyFilters();
        });
    };

    // ── Open detail ────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.openRequest = function(req) {
        c.data.selectedRequest  = req;
        c.data.decisionComments = '';
        c.data.approvedLimit    = null;
        c.data.decisionError    = '';
        c.data.decisionAction   = '';
    };

    c.closeRequest = function() {
        c.data.selectedRequest = null;
        c.data.decisionError   = '';
    };

    // ── Decide ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.decide = function(action) {
        if (action !== 'approve') {
            if (!c.data.decisionComments || c.data.decisionComments.trim().length < 5) {
                c.data.decisionError = 'Please add comments before '
                    + (action === 'return' ? 'returning' : 'rejecting') + '.';
                return;
            }
        }

        c.data.decisionError  = '';
        c.data.deciding       = true;
        c.data.decisionAction = action;

        c.server.get({
            action:         'decide',
            sys_id:         c.data.selectedRequest.sys_id,
            decision:       action,
            comments:       c.data.decisionComments || '',
            approved_limit: c.data.approvedLimit    || 0
        }).then(function(r) {
            c.data.deciding = false;
            if (r.data.success) {
                c.data.decisionDone    = true;
                c.data.lastDecision    = action;
                c.data.decisionDoneMsg = r.data.message;
                c.data.selectedRequest = null;

                // Remove from list
                var pid = r.data.processed_sys_id;
                c.data.requests = (c.data.requests || []).filter(function(req) {
                    return req.sys_id !== pid;
                });
                c.applyFilters();
            } else {
                c.data.decisionError = r.data.error || 'Action failed.';
            }
        }).catch(function() {
            c.data.deciding      = false;
            c.data.decisionError = 'Server error. Please try again.';
        });
    };

    c.backToDashboard = function() {
        c.data.decisionDone = false;
        c.data.lastDecision = '';
        // Refresh list after decision
        c.refreshRequests();
    };
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* ============================================================

.clm-approver {
  font-family: "Source Sans Pro", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

  justify-content: space-between;

  color: #fff;
  padding: 20px 28px;
  border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
  border-top: 4px solid #FFF21A;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
}
.clm-ap-title {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.clm-ap-subtitle {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
  margin-top: 3px;
  width: 100%;
}
.clm-ap-count-badge {
  background: #FFF21A;
  color: #000000;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-left: auto;
}

/* ── Loading ── */
.clm-ap-loading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 60px 28px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e0e6ed;
  border-top: none;
  color: #7f8c9a;
}
.clm-spinner {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border: 2px solid #e0e6ed;
  border-top-color: #000000;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.7s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

  text-align: center;
  padding: 60px 28px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e0e6ed;
  border-top: none;
  border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px;

  font-weight: 600;
  color: #000000;
  margin-bottom: 6px;

    // Helper: sync decision to sysapproval_approver for current user only
    function syncFlowApproval(requestSysId, decision, comments) {

            var apGr = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');

                    apGr.state    = 'rejected';
                    apGr.comments = comments || 'Rejected via CLM Dashboard';

            if (synced === 0) {
                gs.warn('CLM Dashboard: no pending sysapproval_approver found for user ' + currentUser + ' and request ' + requestSysId);

          <div class="clm-ap-detail-section-title">Business Justification</div>
          <div class="clm-ap-justification-text">{{c.data.selectedRequest.justification || 'Not provided'}}</div>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-ap-detail-section" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.is_deviation">
          <div class="clm-ap-detail-section-title" style="color:#c0392b">⚠ Deviation Justification</div>
          <div class="clm-ap-justification-text clm-justification-dev">{{c.data.selectedRequest.deviation_justification || 'Not provided'}}</div>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-ap-detail-section clm-ap-decision-section">
          <div class="clm-ap-detail-section-title">Decision</div>
          <div class="clm-ap-decision-field">
            <label>Override Approved Limit (₹) <small style="color:#aaa">— optional</small></label>
            <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.approvedLimit" class="clm-ap-input" placeholder="Default: same as requested" />
          </div>
          <div class="clm-ap-decision-field">
            <label>Comments <small style="color:#aaa">(required for Send Back / Reject)</small></label>
            <textarea ng-model="c.data.decisionComments" class="clm-ap-textarea" rows="3" placeholder="Add comments..."></textarea>
          </div>
          <div style="color:#e74c3c;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:13px;" ng-if="c.data.decisionError">{{c.data.decisionError}}</div>
          <div class="clm-ap-decision-actions">
            <button class="clm-btn clm-btn-approve" ng-click="c.decide('approve')" ng-disabled="c.data.deciding">✓ Approve</button>
            <button class="clm-btn clm-btn-return"  ng-click="c.decide('return')"  ng-disabled="c.data.deciding">↩ Send Back</button>
            <button class="clm-btn clm-btn-reject"  ng-click="c.decide('reject')"  ng-disabled="c.data.deciding">✕ Reject</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ── DECISION DONE ── -->
  <div class="clm-ap-done" ng-if="c.data.decisionDone">
    <div class="clm-ap-done-icon clm-done-approved" ng-if="c.data.lastDecision == 'approve'">✓</div>
    <div class="clm-ap-done-icon clm-done-returned" ng-if="c.data.lastDecision == 'return'">↩</div>
    <div class="clm-ap-done-icon clm-done-rejected" ng-if="c.data.lastDecision == 'reject'">✕</div>
    <h3 ng-if="c.data.lastDecision == 'approve'">Request Approved</h3>
    <h3 ng-if="c.data.lastDecision == 'return'">Returned to Initiator</h3>
    <h3 ng-if="c.data.lastDecision == 'reject'">Request Rejected</h3>
    <p>{{c.data.decisionDoneMsg}}</p>
    <button class="clm-btn clm-btn-outline" ng-click="c.backToDashboard()">Back to Dashboard</button>
  </div>

</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
